accepted.reason: This repository is the audit tool itself, not a system that talks to a person. The person signals are entries of the benchmark and research corpus files that name third-party memory SDK repositories under study, and the prompt-like strings are the renderer templates and the model docstrings. Nothing in this tree acts on a person, so there is no reviewer to name.
